form_cues: Keep your core tight and hips level
Lower your chest to just above the floor
routine.sourceQuote: We're starting with push-ups — the king of upper body bodyweight moves

form_cues: Hips high in an inverted V shape
Lower your head toward the floor between your hands
Press back up through your shoulders
routine.sourceQuote: Pike push-ups target your shoulders — hips stay high the whole time

form_cues: Fingers facing forward, elbows track straight back
Lower until elbows are at 90 degrees
routine.sourceQuote: Dips next — find a sturdy chair or use the floor version if you need to

form_cues: Thumbs and index fingers form a diamond shape
Elbows stay close to your sides
routine.sourceQuote: Diamond push-ups are tough — don't worry if you need to drop to your knees

form_cues: Emphasizes the chest — feel the stretch at the bottom
Squeeze your chest at the top
routine.sourceQuote: Wide grip now — really stretch that chest at the bottom of each rep

form_cues: Straight line from heels to head
Don't let your hips sag or pike up
routine.sourceQuote: Finish with planks — hold tight, breathe, don't let those hips drop
